Sign Convention in the Mirror Formula: why is u negative? u = +25 or −25? Class 10 Physics, Light.

• New Cartesian sign convention: the pole is the origin, the principal axis is the x-axis
• Left of the pole is negative, and the object is always on the left, so u is negative
• Same rule: a concave mirror's focus is in front, so f is negative
• Worked example: f = −15 cm, u = −25 cm gives v = −37.5 cm, a real image
